SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(rev.r, 0) - COALESCE(ref.f, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id) rev ON rev.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS f FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id) ref ON ref.eid = e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) IN ('2024', '2026') GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT substr(order_date, 1, 4)) = 2)

SELECT m FROM (SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS m, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) AS items, COUNT(rt.id) AS rets FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2024' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY m) ORDER BY (rets * 1.0 / items) DESC, m LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Beverages' AND p.active = 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS emp, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.emp = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS emp, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.emp = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT substr(order_date, 1, 4)) = 2)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01'

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h24, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 IS NOT NULL AND h24 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(h25, 0) - h24) / h24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-06' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) NOT BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 > 0 AND h25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (h25 - h24) * 1.0 / h24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Tabuk' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30'

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r24, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Tabuk' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS rid, r.name AS rname, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,6,2) BETWEEN '07' AND '12' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) SELECT rname FROM rev WHERE r24 IS NOT NULL AND r24 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(r25,0) - r24) / r24 ASC, rname LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id=c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id=ci.region_id WHERE o.status='delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') AND substr(o.order_date,6,2) BETWEEN '07' AND '12' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 DESC, name LIMIT 1
